blocks.title: Kettle's on, special brew today · /special-brew opens
blocks.dek: Mike: 'create a kettle app, that celebrates, special brew.' /kettle is the cooperative kitchen where the room boils together. /special-brew is the sibling celebration — one brew per UTC day, the same one for everyone in the world that day, ~35 brews in rotation. Pour the cup, hear the brass chime, count the cups poured by the room. Today: the rotation picks one — open the page to see what.

blocks.title: UES Track 05 — The Rebuildable Town · a field study in inhabitable software
